about: Porwal Auto Components Ltd is a Pithampur-based ferrous foundry manufacturing ductile/SG iron, grey iron and steel-alloy castings, machined components and sub-assemblies. It uses green-sand and lost-foam vacuum-assisted moulding for automotive, railway /locomotive, defence, heavy-engineering, pumps and oil & gas applications, and also operates captive solar plants.
